_evidence: 0x0040f112 exits unless byte 0x00852d8c is zero (test 0xff) and byte 0x007c2ea9 equals 0x80, so both draw mostly the passing value and sometimes others. It then tests the cell table 0x007c3260 (99 rows x 22, see rec_0040f112): the first cell row+pos, else a scan of the 22 cells of the row for a zero (loop exhausts -> exit). Cells are zero in 1/10 of draws so the direct hit, a found zero and an all-nonzero row (0.9^22 ~ 10%) all occur; nonzero cells are car numbers with or without bit 7.
